card.name: Digits inside dose amounts before repeat
card.fires_on: Mostly a trailing digit (often 0) inside a multi-digit dose number such as 1,000 or 750, in a dosing schedule where the dose will be repeated (twice or three times daily). Also fires on a few linking words in lists.

modes.label: Last digit of a dose
modes.description: The final digit of a number like 1,000 mg or 750 mg, just before a repeated-dosing phrase.
modes.example: plus amoxicillin 1,00<<0>> mg three times daily (in the morning

modes.label: Linking words in lists
modes.description: A small word like 'and' or 'of' inside a list or tablet-count phrase.
modes.example: read, write,<< and>> execute for owner, group, and other

card.writes: It nudges the model toward words about repeating, such as repeated, repeatedly and repetitive.
card.plain: It fires on the end of a dose number when the text is about to say how often the dose is repeated.
